B suggests no renames or new tiers, though it still pads the scale (xs, space-5, space-10) and adds handoff-doc extras. Both answers say their contrast figures are hand estimates that should be checked. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers find too many problems in a set that is already coherent. A does less harm: it skips the restructure, renames nothing, and its additions follow the existing naming pattern. B suggests a primitive tier, renaming --text-md, z-index and scrim tokens, and many surface and status additions, which makes it longer and further from a sanity pass. Both say their contrast figures were worked out by hand and should be checked, but both still state some ratios as fact.
